text: Depressive disorder is a leading cause of disability worldwide, and selective serotonin reuptake inhibitors (SSRIs) remain first-line pharmacotherapy. However, the efficacy and safety of adding Chinese patent medicines (CPMs) as adjunctive therapy to SSRIs have not been systematically evaluated in a network meta-analysis.
source_label: Comparative efficacy and safety of seven Chinese patent medicines combined with SSRIs for depressive disorder: a systematic review and network meta-analysis
